name: Eprosartan

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States

examples.title: Host Response Mediators in Coronavirus (COVID-19) Infection - Is There a Protective Effect of Losartan and Other ARBs on Outcomes of…

summary: In the United States, Eprosartan carries a boxed warning, which is the strongest type of safety alert on a drug's label. A small computer model, not testing on real people, gave the drug a high risk score of 65 for the liver and a low risk score of 44 for the heart [M]. Additionally, one clinical study involving the drug was stopped because a monitoring board found it was not working as hoped [4].
